info.name: Movie API
info.description:
API tests for the deployed Movie API (contract: docs/api.md). Set `baseUrl` in the environment to the Cloud Run URL (no trailing slash) and run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner.

**Data warning:** Each run of the collection adds one movie named `0 Pmtest <runId>` to the real database. There is no delete endpoint: remove leftovers by hand in the Firestore console. If a test of a 400 or 413 request fails, that request may have stored a movie whose name starts with `0 Pmtest`; delete it the same way.

item.name: 01 Add movie
item.description:
POST /api/v1/movies: create (201, Location, trimmed texts), fetching the new movie through its Location (GET /api/v1/movies/{id}, 200 with the same body), an unknown id (404), the duplicate rule (409 with movieId), rule violations, unknown fields, malformed JSON, a wrong type (400 problem details) and a body over 256 KB (413). Only the first request is meant to store a movie.

Each run of the collection adds one movie named `0 Pmtest <runId>` to the real database. There is no delete endpoint: remove leftovers by hand in the Firestore console. If a test of a 400 or 413 request fails, that request may have stored a movie whose name starts with `0 Pmtest`; delete it the same way.
